title: Leave Ledger Report showing duplicate / repeated rows

posts.name: Yuga286
posts.cooked:
Hi Team,
We are facing an issue with the Leave Ledger report. For a single Leave Allocation or Leave Application, the same transaction is being repeated multiple times in the report.
Example:

  • For employee et emp (test employee)
  • Period: 01-07-2025 to 30-09-2025
  • A single allocation entry (HR-LAL-2025-03585) appears twice.
  • Similarly, Earned Leave allocation (HR-LAL-2025-02368) and other transactions are also shown multiple times.

This makes the report confusing and inflates the records.
Additional Issue:
When trying to open some of the duplicated transaction names directly from the report, the system shows:

Sorry! I could not find what you were looking for.

Expected Behaviour:

  • Each Leave Allocation / Leave Application should only appear once in the Leave Ledger report.
  • Clicking on a transaction name should always open the correct document.

Actual Behaviour:

  • Entries are duplicated/repeated for the same transaction.
  • Some transaction links are broken and lead to the “Sorry! I could not find what you were looking for.” error.
